items.title: Alibaba Cloud Makes Its M890 AI Supernode Available in China
items.title_zh: 阿里云“灵骏真武”M890 AI 超节点在中国上线
items.summary: Alibaba Cloud has begun offering its Lingjun Zhenwu M890 AI supernode instance in China, with Ulanqab as the first deployment region. Enterprise customers can provision 64-card units with high-speed interconnect through the cloud, and the instance is designed to handle inference for mixture-of-experts models with up to 10 trillion parameters.

items.title: Zhipu's API User Base Nears 7 Million as It Adds 50,000-Plus Chinese AI Chips
items.title_zh: 智谱 API 用户数逼近 700 万，并新增逾 5 万张国产 AI 芯片
items.summary: Zhipu's MaaS open platform is reported to have nearly 7 million registered API users, about 2 million more than in early July. The company has also newly activated more than 50,000 domestically developed AI chips to meet rising inference demand.

items.title: ByteDance Reportedly Forms New AI Data and Safety Department
items.title_zh: 字节跳动据报新设 AI 数据与安全部门
items.summary: ByteDance has reportedly formed a new top-level department focused on AI data and safety, placed alongside Seed, Flow and Douyin in its organizational structure. The unit is led by Wang Yinglei, a former TikTok executive who oversaw platform responsibility and livestreaming, and reportedly grew out of an earlier global data team.

items.title: Honor Sets Aug. 12 Launch for Its Robot Phone in China
items.title_zh: 荣耀机器人手机定于 8 月 12 日在中国发布
items.summary: Honor has scheduled the China launch of its Robot Phone for Aug. 12, a device that combines a smartphone with a motorized gimbal camera and AI-assisted subject tracking. The company also highlighted an imaging collaboration with ARRI; pricing, sales channels and broader availability were not disclosed, per IT Home.

items.title: The AI race is moving into data centers as Alibaba Cloud cuts delivery time to 100 days
items.title_zh: AI 竞赛转向数据中心：阿里云将交付周期缩短至 100 天
items.summary: TechNode writes that the AI race is moving beyond models and chips into data-center infrastructure, with tech giants worldwide continuing to ramp up AI compute through GPU purchases and server expansion. Alibaba Cloud is said to have cut its data-center delivery time to 100 days.

items.title: iOS 27 Beta Code Points to China-Specific Apple Intelligence Setup
items.title_zh: iOS 27 测试版代码指向针对中国市场的 Apple Intelligence 方案
items.summary: Code found in iOS 27 beta 5 points to Apple preparing a mainland-China-specific version of Apple Intelligence, but does not confirm a launch date or a local partner. The strings say user requests would be processed on-device and would not be sent to Apple or to the local company providing the required security mechanism.

items.title: DeepSeek Expands Hiring for AI Data-Center Infrastructure
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 扩大 AI 数据中心基础设施团队招聘
items.summary: DeepSeek is recruiting for an IDC data-center team in Beijing, Hangzhou and Ulanqab, with roles spanning data-center planning, construction, testing and operations. The listings seek candidates with backgrounds in electrical engineering, HVAC, automation, energy, communications, computer science and environmental engineering, signaling an expansion beyond model research and software development.

items.title: Manus Says It Will Resume Operating as an Independent Company
items.title_zh: Manus 宣布将作为独立公司恢复运营
items.summary: Manus said it will return to independent operations after its separation from Meta and will continue serving millions of users worldwide. The company warned that some accounts will be affected during the transition, with data generated on or after Dec. 29, 2025 to be deleted from 8 a.m. Aug. 23 for affected users.

items.title: GateTruth: Auditing the Rigor of RTL Design Benchmarks via Mutation Testing
items.title_zh: GateTruth：用变异测试审计 RTL 设计基准的严谨性
items.summary: GateTruth applies mutation testing to audit whether RTL-design benchmark testbenches actually catch broken logic: it certified 46 of 60 testbenches in the author's own suite (killing at least 95% of injected mutants), while 72% of 46 auditable designs in the external RTLLM v2.0 benchmark fell below that floor and three scored 0%. The paper also notes NVIDIA's CVDP benchmark cannot be audited because its public release withholds reference solutions, and that a 4,096-token output cap had silently truncated three of seven evaluated models — rerunning at 16,384 tokens moved one model from fifth place to first.

items.title: Spec Sheets Are Not Kernels: An ISA- and Source-Level Audit of INT8 Availability on NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra
items.title_zh: 规格表不是内核：NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra INT8 可用性的 ISA 与源码级审计
items.summary: This audit traces INT8 (W8A8) support on NVIDIA's Blackwell Ultra GPU (B300), whose spec sheets show a roughly 30:1 FP8-to-INT8 dense-compute ratio versus the 1:1 of H200 and B200, through the PTX ISA, CUTLASS, vLLM and SGLang. It finds a consistent layered withdrawal: PTX never exposes the fifth-generation tensor-core integer path (tcgen05.mma .i8) on sm_103a, CUTLASS skips INT8 UMMA generation for 103a, vLLM fails with a hard runtime error on the first INT8 forward pass, and SGLang's INT8 GEMM stops at Sm90 — leaving a nominally supported format effectively undeployable on B300 by default.

items.title: Lonic: Algorithm-Hardware Co-Design for Energy-Efficient Fully Local Online SNN Training with INT4 Precision
items.title_zh: Lonic：面向 INT4 精度全本地在线 SNN 训练的算法-硬件协同设计
items.summary: Lonic is an algorithm-hardware co-design for energy-efficient fully local online supervised SNN training at INT4 precision, introducing reconfigurable multiplier-free integer PE arrays, a dual-optimization zero-gating strategy, temporal prefix-accelerated local learning dataflow and low-precision weight movement. Compared with Apple M4 and NVIDIA V100 GPUs it reports average energy-efficiency gains of 17.44x and 66.28x respectively (plus 15.95x over an ASIC TPU-like accelerator and 14.64x area efficiency over H2Learn), with code released on GitHub.

items.title: A Fault-Tolerant Spike-Time Interface for Approximate Agreement in Distributed Neuromorphic Systems
items.title_zh: 面向分布式神经形态系统近似共识的容错脉冲时间接口
items.summary: This paper studies how neuromorphic tiles can reach approximate agreement when communication carries only labeled spike times and up to f sender labels may be Byzantine. The proposed Spike-time Interface for Faults (SIF) with SpikeTrim guarantees one-step robust validity for n >= 3f+1 with the tight noiseless contraction factor f/(n-2f), and is evaluated in simulations plus a controlled spiking-classifier experiment.

items.title: Uni-SFU: Algorithm-HW Co-Design for Universal SFUs via Mixed-Degree Piecewise Approximation
items.title_zh: Uni-SFU：基于混合阶分段近似的通用特殊函数单元算法-硬件协同设计
items.summary: Uni-SFU jointly optimizes approximation accuracy and silicon area for special-function units that evaluate nonlinear activation functions, jointly searching across target functions to assign mixed-degree polynomials to nonuniform segments under an RTL-derived area cost model. Validated across over 700 neural networks and three NLP models, it reports mean squared error below 8.22x10^-8 with top-1 accuracy loss within 1.02%, occupying about 6,800 um2 in GF 22nm CMOS.

items.title: NITRO: High-Performance 3D NAND Flash-Based In-Storage Computing with Enhanced Activation Dataflow
items.title_zh: NITRO：基于增强激活数据流的高性能 3D NAND 闪存存内计算架构
items.summary: NITRO is a NAND flash-based in-storage computing (ISC) architecture that buffers intermediate activation values in a fast DRAM subsystem instead of the slow flash array and uses a distributed dataflow with intra-plane data mapping to maximize parallelism. The authors report inference latency reductions of up to 85% compared with the baseline.

items.title: HBF Sucks? A Full-Stack Characterization of High-Bandwidth Flash for KV-Centric LLM Serving
items.title_zh: HBF 行不行？面向 KV 密集型 LLM 服务的高带宽闪存全栈评测
items.summary: Using an extended TokenSim, four two-hour Qwen-Bailian production traces, five MoE/dense models and H100/B200 profiles, this study finds that swapping High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) into an SSD-style Mooncake KV-offloading stack backfires: average end-to-end latency rises 2-5.5x and maximum SLO goodput falls 1.1-2.7x, since writes outnumber reads and the tier hits thermal limits. The authors conclude HBF earns its place in LLM serving only when used selectively with reuse-aware placement, write budgeting and thermal coordination.

items.title: APEX: Adaptive Expert Prefetching for Memory-Efficient Edge MoE Inference
items.title_zh: APEX：面向内存受限边缘 MoE 推理的自适应专家预取
items.summary: APEX is a predictive resource-management framework that overlaps expert loading with useful computation for memory-limited edge MoE inference, using a lightweight prefetch router with a learned confidence model to fetch candidate experts ahead of the attention block. It reports over 99% overlap accuracy, and its correctness-preserving mode cuts per-token latency by up to 26% and energy-delay product by up to 41% over state-of-the-art baselines.

items.title: FQTree: Fine-grained Quantization and Hardware Generation of Boosted Decision Trees
items.title_zh: FQTree：梯度提升决策树的细粒度量化与硬件自动生成
items.summary: FQTree introduces fine-grained quantization-aware training of boosted decision trees using a hardware-oriented leaf-value scheme (a global quantization step with a tree-wise shift), plus the QXGB framework for automatic hardware generation via a compiler-based flow. Results on JSC, MNIST and NID show LUT usage reduced by 26-57% compared with state-of-the-art FPGA-based BDT designs while matching or improving accuracy.

items.title: Do Not Let CNOTs Overwhelm the Decoder: Scheduling Transversal Gates for Fast FTQC
items.title_zh: 别让 CNOT 压垮解码器：面向快速容错量子计算的横向门调度
items.summary: This paper studies the classical-decoding cost of transversal CNOT (TCNOT) gates, which can reduce syndrome-extraction rounds in surface-code fault-tolerant quantum computing from O(d) to O(1). The proposed PACE framework combines hybrid window decoding, just-in-time DEM stitching and sub-window parallel decoding to schedule TCNOT gates within decoder resources, mapping the trade-off between quantum acceleration and decoding capacity.
